record.question: What is the primary goal of Antiretroviral Therapy (ART) in children?
options: To suppress the replication of HIV to an undetectable level in the blood
To eliminate the virus from the body
To reduce the chance of transmission to other family members
record.explanation: Answer B: To suppress the replication of HIV to an undetectable level in the blood. Pediatric ART aims to suppress HIV replication to an undetectable viral load, preserve immune function, and prevent disease progression; it does not eradicate HIV. Reference: https://clinicalinfo.hiv.gov/en/guidelines/pediatric-arv. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
